# ImBIOS Skills

> Agent skills for WhatsApp messaging via WAHA (WhatsApp HTTP API), design mocks, social share cards, launch clips, and article images. Start with the skill index below.

## Skills

- [waha-compose](skills/messaging/waha-compose/SKILL.md): Compose WhatsApp messages for WAHA session gateways with native formatting, anti-ban compliance, and phone-screen readability. Use when writing, rewriting, formatting, or reviewing any WAHA sendText body, sendImage caption, reply, group mention, or broadcast text.
  - [Formatting reference](skills/messaging/waha-compose/references/formatting.md): WhatsApp native marks (`*bold*`, `_italic_`, `~strike~`, code, quotes, lists) and WAHA render fields (`linkPreview`, `mentions`, captions).
  - [Compliance reference](skills/messaging/waha-compose/references/compliance.md): WAHA anti-ban rules (reply-first, opt-in, human pacing, errors 463 and 475) plus a pre-send checklist.
  - [Readability reference](skills/messaging/waha-compose/references/readability.md): phone-screen message patterns (notification, reminder, promo, group mention).
  - [Human docs](docs/messaging/waha-compose.md): what it does, when to reach for it, common questions.
- [verified-recordings](skills/browser/verified-recordings/SKILL.md): Record correct demo videos with agent-browser tab capture or OCU plus ffmpeg desktop capture, verified by screenshots. Use for browser tab demos, TigerVNC :1 desktop demos, and X video posts.
- [website-scroll](skills/browser/website-scroll/SKILL.md): Record a top-to-bottom scroll reel of any public page with poster frame. Covers the same use case as the Paralect website scroll skill with an original agent-browser implementation.
- [landing-page](skills/design/landing-page/SKILL.md): Generate a polished hero landing page with a working product demo block as one self-contained HTML file.
- [saas-dashboard](skills/design/saas-dashboard/SKILL.md): Generate a single self-contained HTML dashboard with KPIs, SVG chart, and sortable table.
- [bento-features](skills/design/bento-features/SKILL.md): Generate an HTML bento grid where each cell is a working miniature of one feature.
- [saas-logo](skills/design/saas-logo/SKILL.md): Design flat geometric logo concepts in SVG and export mark plus app-icon PNGs.
- [low-res-mockup](skills/design/low-res-mockup/SKILL.md): Generate a skeleton wireframe of a screen with placeholder blocks instead of copy.
- [og-image](skills/social/og-image/SKILL.md): Generate the static 1200x630 share card from real UI and wire its meta tags.
- [og-image-animated](skills/social/og-image-animated/SKILL.md): Animate the static share card into a short looping reveal as MP4 and GIF.
- [og-image-live](skills/social/og-image-live/SKILL.md): Make a 5 second share clip with scripted product motion inside the card.
- [website-screenshot-reel](skills/social/website-screenshot-reel/SKILL.md): Turn a URL list into a hero slideshow as MP4 and GIF.
- [product-demo](skills/social/product-demo/SKILL.md): Record a polished guided demo of the running app as MP4 with a poster frame.
- [article-image](skills/content/article-image/SKILL.md): Turn a paragraph into a blog illustration in a chosen house style (8 styles).

## Paralect parity note

The design, social, and content buckets cover the same use cases as https://www.paralect.com/skills. Those skills carry no license grant, so everything here is an original implementation with no copied text or code. Each skill links back to its Paralect counterpart. Not affiliated with Paralect.

## Install

```bash
npx skills@latest add ImBIOS/skills --skill waha-compose
```

Claude Code (plugin route):

```bash
claude plugin marketplace add ImBIOS/skills
claude plugin install imbios-skills@imbios
```

## Repo map (mirrors mattpocock/skills)

- `skills/<bucket>/<name>/SKILL.md`: the skill (frontmatter `name` + `description`).
- `skills/<bucket>/<name>/agents/openai.yaml`: display name and invocation policy.
- `skills/<bucket>/<name>/references/`: deep guidance loaded as needed.
- `skills/<bucket>/README.md`: bucket index.
- `docs/<bucket>/<name>.md`: human-facing page (What it does, When to reach for it, Common questions, It's working if).
- `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`: plugin manifests.
